study: Investigate and repair new-to-user recommendation failures

best.interpretation: Negligible observed change; no meaningful generalization gain established. Repeated leaderboard selection.

rejected_hypotheses: Separate classifier using expanded semantic features
Soft training targets for unresolved Top5 frequency ties
Directed historical transitions to new-to-user programs
limitations: All temporal windows were reused for adaptive development; long overlaps short windows
All paired bootstrap intervals include zero
ID-zero title-family context did not reveal missing unseen target history on these validation cohorts
New-item discrimination remains weak; six trained fits did not produce the hoped-for score jump
No future titles, genres or viewing behavior were used as features
Study does not establish an upper bound or prove 0.50 is impossible
verification: Both fitted models reloaded, 11 signals recomputed, 415412 shared feature pairs cross-checked, 1260 prediction rows verified with official candidate IDs
report: Still deferred; earlier PDF is stale
